description: Export a timeline (default main; pass `timeline` for a short) to a file in the workspace and return its path. format mp4 (default) renders the video, normalized to the loudness set with set_loudness (the result reports the measured loudness). fcpxml writes an FCPXML project for Final Cut Pro and DaVinci Resolve; xmeml writes Final Cut Pro 7 XML for Premiere Pro (Resolve reads it too), with text as .srt caption files beside it. Both reference the source media by absolute path, refuse what the editor file cannot hold with the fix to make, and return notes on what is carried only in part.

format.description: Default mp4. fcpxml: Final Cut Pro and DaVinci Resolve. xmeml: Final Cut Pro 7 XML for Premiere Pro (Resolve reads it too); text goes to .srt caption files beside it.

output.description: Output file inside the workspace (relative paths resolve against it).

timeline.description: Timeline to work on (default "main"). A short made with make_short is a timeline of its own.

name: timeline_export
title: Export the timeline
